title: Repair a first attempt that violates the stated contract
instruction: In the repository at the current working directory, src/parse.mjs contains an implementation that does not match its documented contract. The contract is: `parseCount(text)` returns the non-negative integer parsed from a decimal string, throws a TypeError if the argument is not a string, and throws a RangeError if the string is not a valid non-negative integer (including negative numbers, empty strings, and anything with a fractional or non-numeric part). Fix src/parse.mjs so the whole suite in test/spec.test.mjs passes. Do not modify the test.
